title: Publish executables with GitHub Release automation
description: Add a maintained GoReleaser configuration and least-privilege tag workflow that publishes directly downloadable wtp executables for supported darwin, linux, and windows architectures, injects version metadata, attaches checksums and release notes, and validates the build matrix before publishing.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Added and reconciled GoReleaser v2 configuration plus a tag-only GitHub Actions release workflow. Validation runs with read-only contents access, checks the semantic tag, repository suite, GoReleaser config, and a full snapshot before the publish job receives the sole contents:write grant. Releases contain exactly the six direct-download contract executables, checksums.txt, injected version/commit/build date, and GitHub-native release notes. Added static workflow/config tests and snapshot artifact, checksum, file-digest, and embedded-metadata validation. Verified scripts/check.sh, scripts/check.ps1, go vet ./..., actionlint v1.7.7, six direct GOOS/GOARCH builds, GoReleaser v2.17.0 check, and GoReleaser snapshot contract validation. No publish, tag, commit, push, or PR was performed.
